summary: Twilio SMS/OTP feature end-to-end tested. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases PASSED (test_sms_twilio.py) covering /api/sms/status (unconfigured), /api/sms/otp/send auth/E.164/503-on-placeholder, /api/sms/otp/verify wrong-code/expired/success/replay, UserOut phone+phone_verified fields, /api/sms/test 400-when-unverified and 503-on-placeholder. OTPs inserted directly via motor to exercise verify happy-path without real Twilio. Frontend: 7/7 mobile UI checks PASSED at 390x844 -- /verify-phone renders title/phone-input/send-otp-button/skip-phone, the sms-not-configured warning is shown when /api/sms/status returns configured:false (and send-otp-button correctly becomes aria-disabled), skip-phone navigates to /(tabs), Profile shows verify-phone-cta when phone_verified=false and navigates to /verify-phone on tap, Profile shows profile-phone + send-test-sms when phone_verified=true (after direct mongo flip), send-test-sms with placeholder creds renders 'SMS is not configured' in sms-result. Sign-up of a new account redirects to /verify-phone (not directly to tabs). No deprecated expo packages or red-screen errors detected. Two console-warning observations only (non-blocking): RN web prop 'pointerEvents is deprecated', and the expected 503 for /api/sms/test surfaces a generic browser console error log (handled in UI). Overall feature works correctly with placeholder credentials and is ready for real Twilio creds to be dropped into backend/.env.

issues: Because send-otp-button is disabled while smsConfigured===false, the bad-E.164 error path is not reachable from the UI when credentials are placeholders. This matches the design intent but means the requested 'bad e164 shows backend error' scenario can only be exercised after real Twilio creds are configured (or by removing the disabled guard). The backend correctly returns 400 in that branch (verified via pytest).

action_items: Drop real TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID / TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN / TWILIO_FROM_NUMBER into /app/backend/.env and restart backend (sudo supervisorctl restart backend). After that, retest /api/sms/status -> {configured:true}, /api/sms/otp/send happy path, and /api/sms/test happy path.

OPTIONAL UX: /verify-phone disables send-otp-button entirely when sms is not configured. Consider also showing the same warning (or a banner) on the Profile verify-phone CTA so the student knows tapping it will dead-end. Currently they can still skip from inside the screen.

OPTIONAL: Replace the deprecated 'pointerEvents' prop usage (RN warning in console) by moving it to style.pointerEvents. Source likely inside one of the @expo/vector-icons or react-native-web components; non-blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: sms.py correctly treats placeholder values as unconfigured and raises SmsConfigError -> mapped to 503 in server.py. Clean separation.
Rate-limit: 60s per phone in /api/sms/otp/send is implemented via mongo lookup. Good.
OTP verify enforces user_id+phone+code+used:false and sort by created_at desc, then sets used:true and stamps phone_verified:true atomically. Looks correct.
UserOut now includes phone and phone_verified; AuthContext User type already has them. /api/auth/me returns them.
Frontend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (NOT EXPO_BACKEND_URL). Confirmed routing works through the preview ingress.
All interactive elements on /verify-phone and Profile carry testIDs as specified.
No mongodb '_id' leaked in any response touched (all find_one calls use {'_id': 0} projection).
Note: server.py is 940 lines -- still under 1000 but starting to grow; consider splitting SMS routes into a sub-router (e.g. routes/sms.py) for future maintainability.
seed_data_creation: Created a transient signup user test_signup_<ts>@olemiss.app during the signup-redirect test. Cleaned up afterwards via mongosh. Also cleared any OTP docs and reset student@olemiss.app phone/phone_verified to absent so other tests are unaffected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: After real Twilio creds are added to backend/.env, rerun /app/backend/tests/test_sms_twilio.py -- the 503 expectations in test_send_valid_e164_placeholder_creds_503 and test_test_verified_user_placeholder_creds_503 will need to be updated to 200 (and you'll need to use a Twilio test/verified destination number). All other tests should still pass.
rca_of_issue: No bug found in the SMS feature. Placeholder Twilio credentials behave exactly as designed: /api/sms/status -> {configured:false}, /api/sms/otp/send -> 503, /api/sms/test -> 503. Frontend reflects this via the testID='sms-not-configured' warning and a disabled send-otp-button on /verify-phone, and via the inline 'SMS is not configured' text under testID='sms-result' on Profile.
